heading: INT. APIARY CONVENTION - HONEY TASTING TENT - DAY

units.text: INT. APIARY CONVENTION - HONEY TASTING TENT - DAY
White canvas.
Folding tables laid with jars of every color from straw to tar.
Hundreds of beekeepers murmur.
A glass observation hive hums beside the podium.
DETECTIVE INSPECTOR INGRID LARK (40s, plain suit, notebook) walks the aisle.
She stops at a stall where HORTENSE ABERNATHY (60s, honey sommelier, white gloves) arranges jars.
Mrs. Abernathy. About Alistair Penhallow.
units.name: LARK

units.text: Terrible business.
units.name: HORTENSE

units.text: He died at this table.
units.name: LARK

units.text: He tasted the buckwheat and went blue.
units.name: HORTENSE

units.text: You handed him the spoon.
units.name: LARK

units.text: I handed everyone a spoon.
units.name: HORTENSE

units.text: A MAN IN A BEEKEEPER'S VEIL (50s, tall, gloves) drifts behind Hortense, studying the observation hive.
Lark glances at him.
Sir. Your name?
units.name: LARK

units.text: Ask the queen.
units.name: MAN IN VEIL

units.text: I'll ask you.
units.name: LARK

units.text: The man lifts his veil.
He is KONSTANTIN GRIGORIEV (50s, weathered, one blue eye, one brown).
Grigoriev. I sold Alistair his bees.
units.name: KONSTANTIN

units.text: Then you know what killed him.
units.name: LARK

units.text: Oleander nectar. A swarm that fed on it by the river.
units.name: KONSTANTIN

units.text: That's impossible. Those hives were mine.
units.name: HORTENSE

units.text: Were they?
units.name: KONSTANTIN

units.text: A CLERK, FRANCISCO "PACO" LEMUS (20s, convention lanyard), hurries in carrying a ledger.
Inspector! The registry. Hive twelve was transferred last Thursday.
units.name: PACO

units.text: To whom?
units.name: LARK

units.text: Mrs. Abernathy.
units.name: PACO

units.text: Hortense sets down a jar.
The room does not go silent, but the nearest ring of beekeepers does.
She peels off her glove, finger by finger.
Alistair planned to expose me. The adulterated honey. The syrup.
units.name: HORTENSE

units.text: So you poisoned him.
units.name: LARK

units.text: So I fed him his own greed.
units.name: HORTENSE

units.text: DR. ISOLDE VANCE (30s, lab coat under a rain jacket, evidence bag in hand) pushes through the crowd and holds up the bag.
A single dead bee lies inside.
Oleander residue. Confirmed. In the spoon.
units.name: ISOLDE

units.text: Lark closes her notebook.
Behind them, the observation hive hums louder, and something in the glass catches the light: the queen, laying, indifferent.
